title: Tembleque
description: Tembleque is a dish from Puerto Rico featuring coconut milk, cornstarch, toasted coconut flakes. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Dissolve or bloom the setting ingredients as directed, combine with the base and refrigerate for about 16 minutes until fully set.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 160 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
